purpose: Hermes skills that put Jev in charge of small decisions: which model answers, which of many skills to load, which memories and turns survive a summary.
use_when: A Hermes fleet wants cheap typed decisions in front of expensive model calls.
dont_use_when: Owner declined 29/10; workers already run the cheapest lane, so model routing has nothing to save, and verification tiering was not approved.

name: token-saver
purpose: Our own skill: thin large tool output, skip repeated commands, gate scheduled LLM sessions on real state changes, and measure daily tokens per profile.
use_when: A cron job wakes an expensive agent session on a timer, raw command output fills the context, or daily token spend needs a baseline and a verdict.
dont_use_when: Does not compress instruction files or memory; that trades away decisions the agent relies on and needs owner approval first.
